profile.name: Richard Ong
profile.headline:
Secure the infrastructure.
Build the software.
Edit the story.
profile.intro: Enterprise IT stability, AI-assisted development, and high-retention video production—driven by 15+ years of hands-on experience.
profile.bio: I am an output-driven IT professional and digital creator with over 15 years of enterprise infrastructure experience managing network stability and remote operations across 100+ branches. Alongside my technical background, I leverage modern AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Antigravity) to bridge the gap between complex problem-solving and rapid full-stack web development (Python, Flask, SQLite). I am also an experienced short-form video editor and digital content creator, specializing in high-retention storytelling, pacing, and dynamic visual assets.
profile.approach: My work style is independent, highly resourceful, and output-oriented. I combine deep technical reliability with modern AI-native workflows to prototype software, manage digital assets, and execute creative media projects rapidly. My goal is to partner with forward-thinking teams as a versatile remote generalist, developer, or video editor who can turn abstract objectives into polished, deployed results.
